method: Manual review of all four final viewport PNGs and four evenly spaced decoded frames per final GIF; media.json independently checks actual frame/timing and encoded artifacts.
observations: Web summary retains current plan, currency and authorized scope; sources show the separate outside reversal.
Mobile captures show actual long-page viewports; the second viewport includes the comparison totals and source controls, not every source row.
GIF samples show actual source filtering and paging with no identity input. Web uses scrollable ledger tables; mobile uses readable fact rows.
scope: Isolated synthetic business data; no real-device, cloud, model or production acceptance.
